tools.name: astroway_account_status
tools.description: Check current API key status: tier, credit balance, rate limits, monthly cycle reset. Run this BEFORE invoking expensive endpoints (Tier 4+ at 100+ credits, Tier 6/7 at 500-5000 credits) to confirm the user has budget. Returns plain-text human-readable summary.

tools.name: astroway_cost_estimate
tools.description: Estimate the credit cost of one or more endpoints WITHOUT invoking them. Returns total + per-endpoint breakdown with tier annotations. Useful when planning multi-step workflows: estimate first, ask user confirmation, then invoke. Cache TTL 5 min.

tools.name: astroway_agent_tools
tools.description: Tool definitions for an agent framework, generated from the live OpenAPI document, so the schema a model fills is the schema the endpoint validates. `format=openai` (default) returns `{ type, function }` objects you can spread straight into a chat completion; `format=anthropic` returns `{ name, desc

tools.name: astroway_mcp_ai_chat
tools.description: Chat answered from the positions we computed for this birth moment, not from the model's memory of a sun sign. Carries up to 10 turns of history, replies in 21 languages, and takes four voices through `persona`. Send your own provider key and the turn costs 5 credits instead of the endpoint price.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "psychological" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: astroway_agent_tools, astroway_mcp_rag_search · Private data: astroway_account_status, astroway_agent_tools · Public sink: astroway_mcp_ai_chat, astroway_mcp_ai_comparison_coach, astroway_mcp_ai_explain_aspect, astroway_mcp_ai_explain_transit, astroway_mcp_agent_debate, astroway_mcp_multi_agent_coordinate, astroway_mcp_multi_chart_context, astroway_mcp_rag_search, astroway_mcp_streaming, astroway_mcp_tool_call_stream, astroway_psychological_modern_arroyo_cycle_of_becoming, astroway_psya_cycle_of_becoming, astroway_psychological_modern_arroyo_element_balance, astroway_psya_element_balance, astroway_psychological_modern_arroyo_element_integration, astroway_psya_element_integration, astroway_psychological_modern_arroyo_relational_element_map, astroway_psya_relational_element_map, astroway_psychological_modern_arroyo_water_houses_trauma, astroway_psya_water_houses_trauma, astroway_psychological_modern_greene_archetypal_figures, astroway_psyg_archetypal_figures, astroway_psychological_modern_greene_individuation_path, astroway_psyg_individuation_path, astroway_psychological_modern_greene_lunar_myth, astroway_psyg_lunar_myth, astroway_psychological_modern_greene_parental_imagos, astroway_psyg_parental_imagos, astroway_psychological_modern_greene_saturn_shadow, astroway_psyg_saturn_shadow, astroway_psychological_modern_rudhyar_cycles_of_becoming, astroway_psyr_cycles_of_becoming, astroway_psychological_modern_rudhyar_lunation_phase, astroway_psyr_lunation_phase, astroway_psychological_modern_rudhyar_personality_keynote, astroway_psyr_personality_keynote, astroway_psychological_modern_rudhyar_symbolic_degrees, astroway_psyr_symbolic_degrees, astroway_psychological_modern_rudhyar_transits_as_rebirth, astroway_psyr_transits_as_rebirth · Destructive: astroway_account_status, astroway_agent_tools, astroway_mcp_multi_agent_coordinate.
